text:
emma: quick follow-up from today's all-hands — thanks for the Q&A. two asks: 1) link to the incident RCA and 2) owners + short timeline for the mitigation work so leadership can track progress.

raj: RCA posted: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RCA-2026-07 — root cause was a multi-tenant routing regression on our policy router. short summary: bad hash switch + fallback route thrash.

mike: noted. i'll own the immediate mitigation (canary rollback + stricter routing checks). target: finish rollback + smoke in <48h. will post status in #eng-sre. @emma — can you add the rollback to the action tracker?

emma: added to tracker: https://docs.redwood.com/ops/action-tracker (row 34). assigning to mike, due 48h.

ana: quick clarifying q — does the RCA call for a config guard or code fix?

raj: both. short-term: config guard (feature flag + threshold) we can ship fast. long-term: remove the brittle hash logic and add property-based tests.

jess: leadership asked if this changes our SLO targets/credits for customers — answer: not yet, but need impact window in SLA communication. can someone draft a one-pager for customers?

mike: i'll draft a customer-facing note by EOD tomorrow. cc @jess for review.

emma: other action items i tracked:
- Action: config guard behind flag — owner: raj — due: 24h
- Action: rollback + smoke testing — owner: mike — due: 48h
- Action: customer note draft — owner: mike — due: EOD tomorrow
- Action: long-term architecture fix + tests — owner: eng-runtime — due: next sprint (sprint 27)

raj: added a short checklist in the RCA doc for oncall: steps, commands, and who to ping. snippet:
```
# quick rollback
kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deploy/policy-router
# validate
curl -s https://health.redwood.internal/policy | jq .status
```

deploy-bot: deploy 2026-07-13T16:02Z -> policy-router:v2.1.4 completed with warnings (throttles).

ana: thanks — can we get a short postmortem slide for next all-hands? even 1 slide w/impact + next steps.

emma: yes — mike + raj please co-author a 1-slide summary; i'll include in next all-hands deck. deadline: 72h.

jess: thanks everyone — please @mention me when the customer note is ready. i'll coordinate comms. :thumbsup:

emma: closing notes: I'll run a quick sync tomorrow 10am PT to check status and unblock anything. invite sent.

mike: cool, joining.

raj: will be there.

emma: thanks all — appreciate the quick turn on this.
